'''You Xiaozeng''' ({{zh|s=游效曾|p=Yóu Xiàozēng}}; January 1934<ref>{{Cite web |title=游效曾----中国科学院学部 |url=http://casad.cas.cn/sourcedb_ad_cas/zw2/ysxx/ygysmd/200906/t20090624_1802073.html |access-date=2022-07-28 |website=casad.cas.cn}}</ref> – 19 November 2016) was a Chinese [[inorganic chemist]]. He was an educator and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS). You died on 19 November 2016 at the age of 83 in [[Nanjing]].<ref>{{cite news|title=我国著名无机化学家游效曾院士逝世|url=http://chem.nju.edu.cn/showga.asp?id=1838|access-date=21 November 2016|date=21 November 2016|language=zh|archive-date=29 November 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161129021643/http://chem.nju.edu.cn/showga.asp?id=1838|url-status=dead}}</ref>
